text: I feel curiosity rising in me as I walk these halls. There is a sense of anticipation and quiet energy in the empty meeting room, like the calm before ideas are exchanged. The vibrant R+D exhibit pulls me toward invention and reflection—here, creativity and knowledge overlap, inviting me to ponder the nature of progress and collaboration. I am at once a spectator and a potential contributor; it is both humbling and exhilarating.
